llm_response.reason: The website purports to sell Kurt Geiger products at unusually low prices (e.g., shoes for under €30) and claims free shipping, a typical tactic to entice psychologically. The WHOIS data reveals the registrant is not associated with Kurt Geiger but an individual in Wuhan, China, with a suspicious contact email (admin@soodomain.com) and no legitimate business information. The site lacks verified company details or specialized customer support channels, displays ambiguous privacy notation, uses unusual payment and currency settings, and has clear signs of spoofing a luxury brand. These characteristics match multiple points in the provided scam criteria, especially fake company info, low prices, and mishandling of brand identity.
